capability: A reusable frame for a whole kind of job
title: Build it once, with slots.

hook.picture: Close on the whale finishing a long careful line; a pod reads it and answers ✓, then the whole line wipes away to blank paper.
hook.words: Every new client, I start from zero.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every new client, I start the prompt from zero.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: consultant opening a blank chat on Monday

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three new lines drawn and wiped, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Each one differs a little.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each prompt fits one case, then dies.

stakes.body: Hours of prompt writing redone per client, and each rewrite forgets something the last one had.

solution_hint: Write the steps once. Leave blanks for facts.

metaphor.body: One line drawn once with blank cards hanging on it; each new job only drops its facts into the blanks.

steps.picture: The whale draws one line, slowly, with four hollow cards hanging from it, tabs blank.
steps.sound: the phrase in tune, one note per card

steps.picture: Push-in: a client pod drops its facts in; the blank tabs fill with colour; the pod reads the line and answers ✓. A second pod, different colours, ✓.
steps.words: New client. Same steps. New facts.
steps.sound: same phrase, new top note each pod

steps.picture: The whale tries to send with one card still blank; the line will not leave and the empty card blinks.
steps.words: An empty blank shows up at once.

steps.picture: The line with its blank cards sits labelled, whale beside it.
steps.words: A prompt that makes prompts: a meta-prompt.

real_case.claim: meta-suite ships nine task-agnostic meta-skills that build reusable structures; four of them take an idea to a shipped deliverable.

honest_limit.picture: A client drops a wrong fact into a blank (raw sienna smudge in the tab). The line runs perfectly; the pod answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: Good steps, wrong fact, wrong answer.

not_this.body: A good frame does not make facts true.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT close shot returns: the same paper, the same finished line. A third client arrives; only its cards change colour in one beat; the line stays.
ending_pattern.callback: In bar 2 the finished line was wiped to blank paper; now the same line stays on the paper and only its cards change.

end_belief.body: Write the steps once. Fill them each time.
